dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Murakaza neza. Nshaka kusaba ubushakashatsi bwawe mu kazi.
dialogue.translation: Welcome. I would like to ask about your work experience.

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Nafashe ubushakashatsi bwinshi, nka kuri ikintu kinini.
dialogue.translation: I have gained a lot of experience, in many things.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Wishyura neza ubushakashatsi bwawe bw’ikwa kabiri.
dialogue.translation: Explain your experience in the second job well.

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Nyuma y’ikwa kabiri, narimoje isano niniyo.
dialogue.translation: After the second job, I received a good salary.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Kubera iki wagombaye gutanga isano niniyo?
dialogue.translation: Why did you decide to give a good salary?

dialogue.speaker: Candidate
dialogue.text: Kugirango ngire ubushakashatsi n’ubumenyi bwiza.
dialogue.translation: So that I could gain good experience and knowledge.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nshaka kwishyuura ibiryo by'ukuri, n'uwundi ubusa bwange ni bwiza.
dialogue.translation: I like to eat healthy food, and my health is good.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nta nshaka gukoresha amajambo menshi, ariko nshaka gutegura ibiryo by'ukuri.
dialogue.translation: I don't want to use many words, but I want to choose healthy food.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mu nzira y'ubusa, ibiryo by'ukuri ni by'ingenzi.
dialogue.translation: In terms of health, healthy food is important.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kandi njye nshaka kwishyuura ibiryo by'ukuri kubera ubusa bwange.
dialogue.translation: And I want to eat healthy food because of my health.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ni byo by'ukuri, gutegura ibiryo byiza ni ingeno.
dialogue.translation: That's true, choosing good food is a virtue.

key_phrases.translation: I like to eat healthy food.
Choosing good food is a virtue.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nshaka kusaba ubufasha kuri kompyuta yanjye, ntibishoboka gutegura.
dialogue.translation: I want to ask for help with my computer, it’s impossible to turn it on.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Wabonye ubwoko bwo kintu kiriho nyuma y’uburyo bw’gutegura?
dialogue.translation: Did you check the type of issue after trying to turn it on?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eee, ntekeye, kandi nta kintu kiriho.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I checked, and there’s nothing there.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Wabona neza kuri ubwoko bwo kintu?
dialogue.translation: Did you look carefully at the type of issue?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eee, ntekeye neza, ariko ntibishoboka gutegura.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I looked carefully, but it’s impossible to turn it on.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nzakubera ubufasha nyuma y’ijoro.
dialogue.translation: I’ll help you after the night.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nshaka gutanga ibintu by’ukuri kuri uwundi muntu.
dialogue.translation: I want to give the real things to another person.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hari uburyo wowe unshaka gutanga ibintu?
dialogue.translation: Is there a way you want to give the things?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ego, nta kuba mu gutanga kubera nka wundi.
dialogue.translation: Yes, there’s no problem in giving because it’s like another.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: By’ukuri, ari uburyo bwiza.
dialogue.translation: Really, it’s a good way.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nta kuba, nshaka gutanga kuri wese.
dialogue.translation: No problem, I want to give to everyone.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mu by’ukuri, ni uburyo bwiza kugirango ubufasha.
dialogue.translation: In truth, it’s a good way to help.
